segments: またサードインパクトを
english: Are you trying to cause Third Impact again?
If I get the Spears, I can fix everything!
I'm trying to save the world!

segments: カシウスとロンギヌス
english: Cassius and Longinus. Both of the Spears are needed.
But the only two Spears that are here are the same...

segments: そういうことか・・・

english: You should get out of there before you turn into an Adams' Vessel.
No. That is not what I was ordered.

segments: あんたのオリジナルはもっと
english: Your original was a lot friendlier, you know.
You say that, but my father, Evas, Misato-san...

segments: おとなしくやられろ！ガキシンジィ！

english: Hey, Glasses! Throw me a spare!
Now's our chance to grab the Spears!
I can't believe he'd hit a girl.
I have a really bad feeling about this.
Remember why we came all the way here?
Those aren't the Spears we came for!
Not... the Spears we came for?
You're the one who said we need the Spears.
That's why I got into this Eva!
for everyone, I will get the Spears!
Only then will the world go back to how it should be.

segments: そうすれば　ミサトさんだって！

english: You're cleared to use AA rounds!
The Twelfth Angel is still alive!

segments: に、こいつを！かたづける！
english: We'll take care of this before Third Impact starts up again!
The whole thing is a core.
There's nothing we can do about it now.
Plus, we don't know *what* might happen once the final Angel is defeated.

segments: どうなっちゃったんだ？カヲル

english: I never thought that I, the First Angel,
would be cast down to the Thirteenth.
What are you talking about, Kaworu-kun?!
So the beginning and the end are the same.
I expected no less from the King of the Lilin,

segments: ＤＳＳチョーカーにパターン
english: Blood type blue from the DSS Choker?
So this is what Gendo-kun was aiming for.
It is time to amend the Dead Sea Scrolls' contract.
Though you have all changed the form of your souls,
you are still creatures blessed with the Fruit of Knowledge.
Though you could have lived for an eternity,
you can escape the fate of death no more than us.
To advance the evolution of the flock burdened by death,
On behalf of humanity, I thank you.
Let death return your souls to where they belong.

segments.reading: じんるいほかんけいかく

english: The long desired Human Instrumentality Project,
and the inevitable deicide, will be completed by me.
Our wishes have come to fruition.
We wish for Human Instrumentality, the peaceful purification of all souls.
We wish for Human Instrumentality, the peaceful purification of all souls.
It's one of the surviving Adams!
Because I pulled out the Spears?
Contain the Eva in its present state!
Prepare the main cannons for a salvo! Load the mortar shells!

segments: なんとしてもフォースの
english: We'll do whatever it takes to keep Fourth Impact in check!
We've taken damage! Direct hit to the main cannons!
Central hull hit! Extent of damage unknown!
Another hit on the central hull!
Severe damage to the third armor plate!
The Adams' Vessel is Wunder's true master.
It intends to take the ship's controls back from Eva-01!
Why can't I restore the link?

segments: こいつはシッチャカメッチャカな
english: That's one hell of a mess they got themselves in.

segments: コネメガネはガキのエヴァを。
english: Glasses, you handle the brat's Eva!
Unable to reject the Adams' Vessel!
Unidentified data is infiltrating the main control system!
It's hijacking control of the ship!

segments: ズルっ！ゼーレのやりそうな
english: No fair! That reeks of Seele.

segments: コード７７７（トリプル・セブン）！

english: Eva-02' has engaged the Adams' Vessel!

segments: 、アヤナミレイならどうするの？
english: What would Ayanami Rei do in this situation?

segments: あんたはどうしたいの！！

english: The whole thing is the core?!
Captain, we must wait until the main engine recovers.
This is all because of me...?

segments: になってしまったからね。
english: It happened because I became the Thirteenth Angel.

segments: ねえ、どうしよう・・・
english: Tell me, what should I do?
what would be the right thing?
Even if your soul disappears, your hopes and curses remain in this world.
Your will roams the world as information and gradually changes.
In time, even your very self is altered.
I'm sorry. This wasn't the happiness you desired.
I'll close the Gates of Guf.
You don't need to worry, Shinji-kun.
What are you talking about, Kaworu-kun?
I don't get it at all!
Shinji-kun, you just need to find peace and a place to call your own.
Don't look at me like that.
The Gates of Guf still hasn't closed!
So, Puppy Boy was Seele's backup!
Get a hold of yourself, Puppy Boy!
And while you're at it, get to know the world a little!
Help out the Princess, at least!
Nearly everything went as Seele had intended.
Even so, we eliminated Seele's boy and guided Eva-13 to its Awakening.
Captain Katsuragi's actions are also within expectations.

segments.reading: しゅけいかいたいせい

english: All ships, remain in secondary state of alert.
No units detected in the monitored airspace.
Emergency repairs to the central hull completed.

segments: のおかげかわからないけれどフォースは
english: I don't know who did it, but Fourth Impact was stopped.
Misato, this should be good enough for now.
You didn't come to help me.
Only thinking about yourself, as usual.

segments: いつまでたっても・・・
english: Always causing trouble, you troublesome brat.
Jeez! You can't even *stand* on your own?!

segments: さっきのパイロットね。

english: From an early lot of Ayanami types, are you?
The L Barrier density is too high here, so they won't be able to come for us.
We'll go someplace where the Lilin can pick us up.
Shinji Ikari is still adrift after losing his will to live.
He'll discover hope at the place he ends up.
Finally the Instrumentality Project is set in motion.

segments: ファイナルインパクト
english: Wille make one last grueling stand to prevent Final Impact.
Wille make one last grueling stand to prevent Final Impact.
The Wunder tears through the sky!
Eva Unit 8+2 races across the red earth!
Next time in "New Evangelion Theatrical Edition".

english: Next Time  New Evangelion Theatrical Edition: ||
